results.title: Commander deck diagnostic
results.hypothesis: Commander players will pay for a fast diagnostic that identifies weaknesses and gives concrete upgrades.
results.buyer: Commander players who want an actionable deck review
results.smallest_test: Put the existing NZ$29 offer in front of 20 qualified Commander owners and measure purchases.

results.title: Wanted-item sourcing service
results.hypothesis: People with unusually specific shopping needs will pay to have an agent search multiple marketplaces and channels for a matching item.
results.buyer: Collectors and shoppers with a highly specific wanted item
results.offer: Submit a wanted item; receive a ranked shortlist and sourcing help.
results.smallest_test: Manually source 10 highly specific requests from existing communities and offer a NZ$15 paid hunt.

results.title: Billboard-as-a-service scarce digital property
results.hypothesis: People will pay for a scarce, visible digital placement when ownership, scarcity, permanence, or attention is clearly packaged.
results.buyer: Creators, collectors, small businesses and communities seeking a persistent digital placement
results.offer: Buy a defined scarce placement with a clear term, location, and proof of ownership/use.
results.smallest_test: Publish one tightly defined scarce placement and solicit 10 qualified prospects.

results.title: Audience pain intelligence brief
results.hypothesis: Creators and small operators will pay for concise, evidence-backed briefs that turn Reddit/Substack/community signals into actionable commercial opportunities.
results.offer: A one-off commercial signal brief with source evidence, buyer hypothesis and smallest test.
results.smallest_test: Create one sample brief from public community signals and offer it to 10 qualified prospects.

results.title: License existing digital artifacts as commercial kits
results.hypothesis: Existing diagrams, templates, specifications and automation artifacts can be packaged and licensed as useful operator kits rather than remaining internal documentation.
results.buyer: AI builders, operators and small businesses
results.offer: One-off commercial kit containing a focused artifact bundle and usage instructions.
results.smallest_test: Select one artifact bundle, write a one-page buyer-facing description, and test it with 10 qualified prospects.

results.title: Digital billboard slot as a service
results.hypothesis: People and small businesses will pay for a permanent or time-bounded claim on a visible digital property surface.
results.smallest_test: Sell one clearly bounded NZ$29-NZ$99 digital billboard slot with a defined placement, duration, and proof of publication.

results.title: ELoM creator asset revival
results.hypothesis: Existing game-world artifacts can be refined into a small paid creator or player experience without rebuilding the entire historical system.
results.smallest_test: Archaeologise one coherent historical mechanic, package a tiny playable or demonstrable slice, and test paid interest before rebuilding the wider game.

results.title: Wanted-item sourcing service
results.hypothesis: People will pay a small fee to have an agent search multiple commerce channels for a highly specific hard-to-find item.
results.smallest_test: Offer a manually fulfilled NZ$15-NZ$29 wanted-item hunt to 10 qualified prospects without depending on one marketplace.
